examples.text: He exhorts the emperor to revive the courage of his subjects by the example of manly virtue; to banish luxury from the court and from the camp; to substitute in the place of the Barbarian mercenaries, an army of men interested in the defence of their laws and of their property
examples.translation: 他劝诫皇帝以男子气概的美德重振臣民的勇气；取缔宫廷和军营中的奢靡之风；以一支忠于捍卫法律和财产的军队取代蛮族雇佣兵

examples.text: If a mercenary died, that was one fewer man to pay. Mercenaries were an efficient way to run a military campaign especially in view of the employer's ability to hire and fire when and if the situation demanded
examples.translation: 如果一名雇佣兵阵亡，那就意味着少付一笔钱。雇佣兵是开展军事行动的有效方式，尤其考虑到雇主可以根据形势需要随时雇佣和解雇他们

examples.text: The combat fatigues worn by the vehicle personnel did not appear to be standard military issue, more similar to what you would expect mercenaries to wear. Mercenaries, loyal to nothing except themselves and their off-shore bank accounts.
examples.translation: 车上人员穿着的作战服似乎并非标准军用制服，更像是雇佣兵的装束。这些雇佣兵，除了自己和他们的海外银行账户之外，什么都不忠。
